<!--axz-cofre--><!DOCTYPE html><html lang="es"><head><meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"><title>AXIZ · ACCESO PRIVADO</title>
<style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 50% at 50% 0%,#12120c,#06060a 70%);
color:#f4f4f8;font-family:Georgia,serif;min-height:100vh}
#puerta{max-width:520px;margin:10vh auto 0;padding:0 22px;text-align:center}
#puerta .p1{opacity:0;animation:pFade .9s ease .2s forwards,pOut .7s ease 5.8s forwards}
#puerta .mani{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:#e8e2d0}
#puerta .mani-sello{width:60px;height:auto;display:block;margin:16px auto 0;transform:rotate(-9deg);
opacity:0;animation:pFade .7s ease 1.1s forwards;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.55))}
#puerta .p1-carga{margin-top:26px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:9.5px;
letter-spacing:2.5px;color:#6f6850;opacity:0;animation:pFade .6s ease 1.6s forwards}
#puerta .p1-grupos{margin-top:12px;min-height:16px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;
font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#e0b13a}
#puerta .p1-grupos span{display:inline-block;opacity:0;animation:pFade .5s ease forwards}
@keyframes pOut{to{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}}
#puerta .p2{opacity:0;animation:pFade .6s ease 6.4s forwards}
#puerta .escudo-cae{animation:caeGira 2.4s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1) 6.5s both}
@keyframes caeGira{0%{transform:translateY(-64vh) rotateY(0deg)}70%{transform:translateY(0) rotateY(600deg)}100%{transform:translateY(0) rotateY(720deg)}}
#puerta .clave-caja{opacity:0;animation:pFade .8s ease 8.7s forwards}
@keyframes pFade{to{opacity:1}}
#puerta .escudo-caja{margin:0 auto 26px;text-align:center}
#puerta .escudo-caja img{width:150px;height:auto;display:inline-block;border-radius:50%;
border:1px solid rgba(224,177,58,.4);
filter:brightness(.72) contrast(1.18) saturate(.82) drop-shadow(0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.7)) drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(224,177,58,.18))}
#puerta h1{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:5px;color:#e0b13a}
#puerta .s{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#8e8ea6;margin-top:10px}
#puerta form{margin-top:30px;display:flex;gap:9px}
#puerta input{flex:1;background:#0d0c09;border:1px solid #3a3426;border-radius:9px;color:#f4f4f8;
font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:3px;padding:13px 16px;outline:none;text-align:center}
#puerta input:focus{border-color:#e0b13a}
#puerta button{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;background:#e0b13a;
color:#0a0805;border:none;border-radius:9px;padding:0 20px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
#aviso{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#e06050;margin-top:14px;min-height:14px}
#puerta .pie{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#5a5648;margin-top:34px;line-height:1.8}
#cargando{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 50% at 50% 40%,#12120c,#06060a 75%)}
#cargando{opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s ease}
#cargando.visible{opacity:1}
#cargando .sello{width:120px;height:auto;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(224,177,58,.4);
animation:giraEscudo 7s linear infinite;
filter:brightness(.72) contrast(1.18) saturate(.82) drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(224,177,58,.2))}
@keyframes giraEscudo{from{transform:rotateY(0deg)}to{transform:rotateY(360deg)}}
#cargando .ct{margin-top:26px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:3.5px;color:#c9a84a}
#cargando .cb{width:150px;height:2px;background:rgba(224,177,58,.14);margin-top:14px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:2px}
#cargando .cb i{display:block;height:100%;width:40%;background:#e0b13a;border-radius:2px;animation:cbCorre 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes cbCorre{0%{transform:translateX(-110%)}100%{transform:translateX(360%)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#cargando .giro,#cargando .cb i{animation:none}}
</style></head><body>
<div id="puerta"><div class="p1"><div class="mani">&ldquo;AXIZ es un sistema de software propio que automatiza la captura, el sellado y la publicaci&oacute;n de inteligencia de mercado &mdash; con una capa de decisi&oacute;n editorial que jam&aacute;s se automatiza del todo, porque el juicio y la responsabilidad tienen que quedar donde se puedan auditar.&rdquo;</div>
<img class="mani-sello" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="sello">
<div class="p1-carga">CARGANDO&hellip;</div>
<div class="p1-grupos"><span style="animation-delay:1.9s">SENTINEL</span><span style="animation-delay:2.4s">&middot; PRISMA</span><span style="animation-delay:2.9s">&middot; BLACK</span><span style="animation-delay:3.4s">&middot; ARGOS</span><span style="animation-delay:3.9s">&middot; OMEGA</span><span style="animation-delay:4.4s">&middot; AURUM</span></div></div>
<div class="p2"><div class="escudo-cae"><div class="escudo-caja"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="escudo AXIZ"></div>
</div><div class="clave-caja"><h1>AXIZ</h1><div class="s">INTELLIGENCE HOLDINGS · ACCESO PRIVADO</div>
<form id="f"><input id="clave" type="password" placeholder="&#9679;&#9679;&#9679;&#9679;&#9679;&#9679;" autocomplete="current-password"><button>ENTRAR</button></form>
<div id="aviso"></div>
<div class="pie">MATERIAL CIFRADO (AES-256) · SE ABRE SOLO EN SU NAVEGADOR<br>
AN&Aacute;LISIS, NO ASESORAMIENTO · 2026-08-04</div></div></div></div>
<div id="cargando"><img class="sello" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="escudo AXIZ">
<div class="ct">ABRIENDO LA CASA&hellip;</div><div class="cb"><i></i></div></div>
<script>
var SAL='wks777BQ/y4iz3YXg8typw==',NONCE='kgS3b5XNoxwNyIJg',COFRE='',VUELTAS=200000;
function b64a(s){var b=atob(s),a=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++)a[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);return a;}
function intenta(clave,silencio){
var enc=new TextEncoder();
return crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',enc.encode(clave),'PBKDF2',false,['deriveKey'])
.then(function(k){return crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:'PBKDF2',salt:b64a(SAL),iterations:VUELTAS,hash:'SHA-256'},k,{name:'AES-GCM',length:256},false,['decrypt']);})
.then(function(llave){return crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:b64a(NONCE)},llave,b64a(COFRE));})
.then(function(plano){try{sessionStorage.setItem('axz_clave',clave);}catch(e){}
var h=new TextDecoder().decode(plano);var e=Math.max(0,1900-(window.axzT0?Date.now()-window.axzT0:0));setTimeout(function(){document.open();document.write(h);document.close();},e);})
.catch(function(){try{sessionStorage.removeItem('axz_clave');}catch(e){}
cargando(false);document.getElementById('puerta').style.visibility='';
if(!silencio){document.getElementById('aviso').textContent='CLAVE INCORRECTA';}});}
function cargando(v){var c=document.getElementById('cargando');c.style.display=v?'flex':'none';if(v){window.axzT0=Date.now();requestAnimationFrame(function(){c.classList.add('visible');});}else{c.classList.remove('visible');}}
document.getElementById('f').addEventListener('submit',function(ev){ev.preventDefault();
var c=document.getElementById('clave').value;if(!c)return;
cargando(true);intenta(c,false);});
try{var g=sessionStorage.getItem('axz_clave');if(g){
document.getElementById('puerta').style.visibility='hidden';cargando(true);intenta(g,true);}}catch(e){}
</script></body></html>
